svg.title: Fosgonimeton, which turns into dihexa, missed its Alzheimer's goals
svg.desc: Fosgonimeton, which turns into dihexa, missed its Alzheimer's goals. Memory and thinking (ADAS-Cog11) (lower is better): placebo -0.39, fosgonimeton -1.09, p = 0.35. Daily function (ADCS-ADL23) (higher is better): placebo -0.02, fosgonimeton +0.65, p = 0.61. Primary endpoint GST p = 0.70.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: LIFT-AD phase 2/3, 312 patients, 26 weeks: change from baseline (points). Neither gap was statistically significant.
